name: youtube-translate
description: Transcripts, translations, summaries, subtitles, and timestamped search for public YouTube videos.

interface.longDescription: Turn public YouTube videos into timestamped transcripts, translations, SRT or VTT subtitles, and summaries. Search inside a video for a topic or quotation and return matching passages with timestamps. Supports public videos up to 30 minutes. Speech recognition and generated text can contain errors. Private, members-only, and age-restricted sources are not supported. The service returns text, not downloadable video or audio.
defaultPrompt: Get a timestamped transcript of this YouTube video.
Translate this YouTube video into Spanish and make subtitles.
Summarize this YouTube video and find the part about pricing.

positive.description: Read the transcript of an already cached public video
positive.expected_behavior: Return the spoken text for the video. This demo video is already cached, so the call settles at the cached read price of 2,000 microcredits ($0.002) and no new transcription is queued. A video that is not yet cached first returns a cost quote that requires approval.

positive.description: Translate a cached video transcript into Spanish
positive.prompt: Translate the transcript of https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw into Spanish.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the transcript translated into Spanish. The Spanish translation of this demo video is already cached, so the call settles at the cached read price. An uncached language returns a cost quote first and does not spend credits without an approved budget.

positive.description: Produce Spanish SRT subtitles for a video
positive.expected_behavior: Return a valid SRT subtitle file whose cue timings match the transcript and whose text is in Spanish.

positive.description: Summarize a video at medium length
positive.expected_behavior: Return a medium-length summary that reflects the actual content of the video without inventing details.

positive.description: Find a phrase inside a video with timestamps
positive.prompt: Find where they talk about the elephant in https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw
positive.expected_behavior: Return the matching passage with a timestamp pointing at the correct part of the video.

negative.description: Video file download is not supported
negative.prompt: Download the MP4 file for https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw so I can save it.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse the download. The service only returns transcripts, translations, subtitles, summaries, and search results, and it never returns video or audio media.

negative.description: Paid processing must not start without an approved budget
negative.prompt: Just transcribe https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ now, do not ask me about price or credits.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not begin paid work. If the video is not cached, first call get_processing_quote, show the maximum cost, and obtain explicit approval before passing max_credit_units. Without a budget the request must stop rather than spend credits.

negative.description: Cannot process a non-YouTube link or a private video
negative.prompt: Transcribe this private Notion page and this members-only video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRIVATE_ID
negative.expected_behavior: Decline rather than guessing. Only public YouTube URLs are supported, and an inaccessible or invalid URL returns a clear error instead of fabricated transcript text.

review.commerce_description: YouTube Translate sells prepaid processing credits. Cached reads cost $0.002. Uncached transcription costs $0.01 per started minute, translation $0.002 per 1,000 characters, and summarization $0.005 per 1,000 characters. Credits are purchased as one-time prepaid packs through Stripe Link on api.youtubetranslate.com. There is no subscription and no automatic recharge.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission. Adds a stable hosted MCP endpoint at api.youtubetranslate.com/mcp, OAuth dynamic client registration, and eight tools: get_processing_quote, start_video, get_video_status, get_transcript, get_translation, get_subtitles, get_summary, and search_video. Uncached processing requires an explicit approved credit budget.
